🇱🇧 🇮🇱 Front line near Nabatieh.

The Israeli capture of Nabatieh would be significant, but it’s still a while away. 

Hezbollah would likely deploy hundreds of fighters to the city to defend, but Israel still has a few more villages to capture before a battle for the city. 

This city falls above the Litani River, and is a significant Lebanese city. I honestly would be shocked if the IDF tried to take it, as they’d likely be forced to withdraw from Nabatieh in any peace/ceasefire arrangement.

🇷🇺 🇺🇦 Battle for Kozacha Lopan began after Russian Army entered in the first dachas north of the town.
